summary: We are looking for a detail-oriented SQL Developer Intern to support our data and development teams. You will work on database design, query optimization, and data-driven reporting while collaborating with engineers and analysts.
responsibilities: Write and execute SQL queries, joins, triggers, and stored procedures.
Assist in designing and maintaining relational database structures.
Perform data cleaning, validation, and migration tasks as required.
Debug SQL-related issues and optimize performance.
Collaborate with backend and analytics teams for data integration tasks.
Prepare documentation for database processes, mapping, and workflows.
Ensure data quality, accuracy, and compliance with standards.
required_skills: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, or related fields.
Good understanding of SQL and relational database management systems.
Familiar with MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQL Server.
Basic knowledge of ETL concepts and data modelling will be an advantage.
nice_to_have_skills: Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
benefits: Mentorship from experienced SQL and data professionals
